werewolf.name: Werewolf
werewolf.description: Each night, the pack gathers and picks a victim. By day, it hides among the villagers.
werewolf.short: Each night, the pack picks a victim.
werewolf.rules: At night, you wake up with the other wolves and vote together for a victim among the non-wolves. By day, hide among the villagers. You win when only wolves are left.

narrator.wake: The werewolves wake up, recognise each other and choose their victim.
narrator.sleep: The werewolves, sated, go back to sleep.

villager.name: Villager
villager.description: No power, only instinct and a voice. Debates and votes to unmask the wolves.
villager.rules: You have no night power. By day, watch, debate and vote to eliminate the wolves. You win with the village when every wolf is dead.

seer.name: Seer
seer.short: Each night, she uncovers one player's secret.
seer.description: Each night, she probes a player and learns their role. She must guide the village without giving herself away.
seer.rules: Each night, pick a living player other than yourself: their role (or only their team, depending on the game options) is added to your notes at once. Only once per night.

narrator.wake: The Seer wakes up and points at the player whose secret she wants to learn.
narrator.sleep: The Seer has seen what she wanted to see. She goes back to sleep.

witch.name: Witch
witch.short: One potion to save, one potion to kill.
witch.description: She knows the night's victim and keeps two potions: one gives life back, the other takes it. Each works only once.
witch.rules: Each night, after the wolves, you see their victim (or nobody). You may save them with your healing potion, poison another player with your poison, use both, or do nothing. Each potion works once per game. Whether you may save yourself depends on the options.

narrator.wake: The Witch wakes up. I show her tonight's victim: does she want to save them, or poison someone?
narrator.sleep: The Witch puts away her vials and goes back to sleep.

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.short: If he falls, he takes his last shot with him.
hunter.description: A villager with his finger on the trigger. Whatever happens to him, he takes someone along.
hunter.rules: You do not act at night. When you die, whatever the cause, you immediately pick a living player, who dies in turn. If you die at night, you shoot at dawn. Without a choice before the timer ends, you do not shoot. Your role is revealed as soon as your shot is awaited.

narrator.shot: With his last breath, the Hunter raises his rifle. Whom does he take with him?

cupid.name: Cupid
cupid.short: On the first night, he binds two hearts for life… and death.
cupid.description: With one arrow, he joins two players. If one dies, the other follows out of grief.
cupid.rules: On the first night only, pick two living players (you may pick yourself): they become lovers and learn each other's role. If one dies, the other dies of grief. A couple made of a wolf and a non-wolf wins if they are the last ones alive. Afterwards, you play with the village.

narrator.wake: Cupid wakes up and shoots his arrow: he points at two lovers.
narrator.lovers_wake: I touch the shoulders of the two lovers. Open your eyes and meet each other.
narrator.lovers_sleep: The lovers go back to sleep, hearts pounding.

little_girl.name: Little Girl
little_girl.short: She peeks while the wolves hunt.
little_girl.description: Curious and daring, she spies on the pack. The more she dares, the more likely she is to be spotted.
little_girl.rules: During the wolves' turn, you may choose to spy. You then see their votes live, each wolf under a name showing only a few letters. Each night of spying raises the risk of being spotted: the wolves then receive a list of three suspects, including you. You win with the village.

narrator.spy: The Little Girl may half-open her eyes… at her own risk.

correction.title: Correction mode
correction.help: Fix the table after a mistake. Every correction is logged and can be undone.

play_mode.label: Where do you play?
play_mode.help: Around a table, or each at home on a voice call.

pilot_mode.label: Night pace
pilot_mode.help: Assisted: steps follow one another as soon as the player has acted. Manual: you move every step.

deal_mode.label: Dealing the roles
deal_mode.help: Everyone at once, or one by one in seat order.

mayor.label: Mayor
mayor.help: A Mayor is elected on the first day; their vote counts twice.

mayor_succession.label: Mayor succession
mayor_succession.help: When the Mayor dies, they choose a successor, or the village elects a new one.

vote_visibility.label: Village vote
vote_visibility.help: Public: everyone sees who votes for whom. Secret: only the result is announced.

allow_spare.label: Spare
allow_spare.help: The ballot offers to execute nobody.

allow_abstain.label: Abstention
allow_abstain.help: A player may cast a blank vote.

tie_break.label: On a tie
tie_break.help: Who decides when two players have as many votes.

wolf_vote_mode.label: Wolves’ vote
wolf_vote_mode.help: Unanimous: every wolf must name the same victim. Majority: the most votes win.

wolves_win_on_parity.label: Wolves win on parity
wolves_win_on_parity.help: The wolves win as soon as they are as many as the others.

seer_mode.label: What the Seer sees
seer_mode.help: The exact role of the probed player, or only their team.

witch_self_save.label: Can the Witch save herself?
witch_self_save.help: With her life potion, when the wolves attack her.

fake_wake_for_dead_roles.label: Call dead roles
fake_wake_for_dead_roles.help: In person, you still call a dead role, so as not to reveal their death.

little_girl_risk.help: The Little Girl’s risk of being spotted while spying: it starts at the base and rises with every night she spies.

reveal_role_on_death.label: Reveal the role of the dead
reveal_role_on_death.help: A dead player’s role is shown to everyone.

dead_see_roles.label: The dead see everything
dead_see_roles.help: A dead player sees everyone’s role.
